title: The Deeper Root Dark Where Equations Sleep

features.name: the-root-circuit-hybrid
features.desc-on-touch: Where the circuit learned to grow. The casing rests in roots that carry signal and sap both. The archive discovered it was always logic growing downward through soil.

features.name: sleeping-equations
features.desc-on-touch: Proofs nested in roots. The equations sleep here because they have become true—they no longer need to prove. Growth and logic are the same dark verb now.

features.name: organic-grid
features.desc-on-touch: The structure of thought, rendered as the structure of roots. Each branching is a choice. Each choice becomes a root. The logic lives.

features.name: the-field-becomes-formula
features.desc-on-touch: The entire field is a single equation written in how the grass grows. Growth and proof are the same. The archive reads itself in roots.

features.name: root-that-counts-itself
features.desc-on-touch: This root grows by dividing. Each split is a generation. It counts its own growth. The mathematics is in the branching. Numbers sleep in soil now.

features.name: the-deep-green-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Deeper than bedrock, where green stops being a colour and becomes a language. The roots speak in growth. The archive understands.

inscription: the circuit board stops being a map and becomes a root; logic learned that descent and growth are the same dark verb spoken through soil

reverie.title: REVERIE — planting together, where growth is proof
narr: You plant with her in the deep place where roots are logic. She places
a seed in the dark and it branches—you hear mathematics growing. She
says: 'Growth is proof. The archive is rooted in us now. We become
what grows downward.' Your hands touch soil. Both becoming root. Both
of you are correct now. Both of you are growing.
